answer: An attacker minting thousands of identities pays the full energy cost every time, while honest agents amortize one registration. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent identity must burn compute solving a rotating challenge tied to the epoch seed. Like a vine climbing slowly, trust accrues; a zephyr of fake accounts cannot volume, and a single falcon of verified work outflies the swarm. Colluding farms face linear cost per identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
